d: City of Jerusalem besieged, with a door in perspective, from which soldiers come out to battle. On one song you can see the tents of the Christian army; there is a huge pavilion with throne on which Godfrey sits surrounded by the Guards, Rinaldo, Almirena, and Eustazio.
It is heard a trumpet, which precedes an Herald sent from the city, and which is accompanied by two guards until the presence of Godfrey.

Argettes comes out of the city in a triumphal chariot pulled by horses and followed by a large number of Guards on foot, and People on horseback, and descending with a solemn courtship he approaches the person of Godfrey, who moves to meet him.
Argettes alone.
Armida in the air, singing by sitting on a chariot pulled by two dragons, which throw flames and smoke out of their mouths.
Place of delights with fountains, boulevards, and birds in which birds fly and sing. Almirena and then Rinaldo.
Armida grabs Almirena from Rinaldo's hands, and wants to take her away.
Goffredo, Eustazio and Rinaldo still, with their eyes fixed on the ground, and submerged in a great confusion.
Rinaldo alone.

Great sea, in which it reflects a beautiful ire; near the lido there is a boat on the anchor, and at the helm of the same there is a spirit in the form of a beautiful woman. Two Sirens are jumping into the waves. Eustatio.
Rinaldo, Goffredo, they're leaving in a hurry.
Delicious garden in the enchanted palace of Armida. Argante and Almirena.
Armida alone.
Two spirits lead Rinaldo to the presence of Armida.
Armida turns into Almirena.
Armida alone, resumes her own form.
Armida takes the form of Almirena, then Argante comes.
Armida and Argante.

Horrid mountain with cliffs and waterfalls, at the top of which you can see the enchanted castle of Armida, which is guarded by a large number of monsters of various forms; in the middle of the walls there is a door with crystal columns and of all sorts of gems; on foot of the mountain there is a cavern, where the Magic dwells. Goffredo and Eustazio considering the height of the mountain.
The Wizard comes out of his cave.
Armida Garden, which holds a stylus in Almirena's chest to kill her. Armida, Rinaldo and Almirena.
Goffredo, Eustazio, and sayings.
Argettes, followed by three generals.
Armida and sayings.
Goffredo, Rinaldo and Almirena.
Eustatio and sayings.
All the military instruments of Christians are heard, and the army with solemn pump, on foot and on horseback, passes before Goffredo and Rinaldo, giving them the usual military greetings.
Argettes goes out with his army, which arranges in order of battle.
Godfrey goes out with all his army and order to fight.
Rinaldo, leading Argante chained.
Eustazio with Almirena leading seco Armida prisoner. Eustazio, Almirena, Armida and sayings.
